description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取证监会对A股公司的监管措施记录。可按股票代码、时间范围进行筛选，返回日期、监管措施类型、类型描述、公告标题、公告链接URL、链接类型、相关依据等数据。当用户想了解A股是否被证监会采取监管措施或追踪公司合规情况时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain records of regulatory measures taken by the CSRC against A-share companies. Filters can be applied by stock code and date range, returning fields such as date, regulatory measure type, type description, announcement title, announcement link URL, link type, and relevant basis. Call this interface when users want to know whether an A-share has been subject to CSRC regulatory measures or track a company's compliance status.

params.name: token
descriptions: 我的Token页有用户专属且唯一的Token。

params.name: stockCode
constraints: 请参考股票信息API获取合法的stockCode。

params.name: startDate
descriptions: 用于获取一定时间范围内的数据。
constraints: 开始和结束的时间间隔不超过10年

params.name: endDate
descriptions: 结束信息日期。用于获取时间范围内的数据，默认值为今天结束。
